title: GLM-5.2-NVFP4 linked to NVIDIA's Hugging Face model page
summary: On 2026-06-26, the GLM-5.2-NVFP4 development line recorded a link to a Hugging Face model page under NVIDIA's account. This is a material reference point for the project's public distribution trail, although the dated link alone does not establish a release date, model revision, or technical specifications.
